info.title: BotHunter Universal API
info.description: Build and manage BotHunter chatbot workflows, users, and variables for Telegram, MAX, VK, and Odnoklassniki communities.

post.description: Creates a BotHunter bot enrollment for a user in a specified channel.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

botId.description: ID of the BotHunter bot to add the user to.

uid.description: User ID in the social network or messenger channel.

channel.description: Channel identifier. Documented values: VK, TG, MAX, OK.

stepId.description: Optional BotHunter step ID to add the user to.

force.description: Use 1 to add the user even if they are already in the bot; use 0 otherwise.

payload.description: Optional additional parameters to pass into the bot. BotHunter accepts a string or structured payload.

botId.description: Bot ID used in the request.

channel.description: Channel code used in the request.

success.description: Whether BotHunter accepted the add-user request.

uid.description: Social or messenger user ID used in the request.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
